note: Generated by docs/forecast/data/rating-audit-split.ts. Old = bulk buoy Hs as the only swell; new = NDBC swell partition as the primary swell, total Hs as combined Hs, faceEstimate as the app builds it. Same hours for old and new. Published split for recent windows; HI/East winter split COMPUTED (GH_RULE) for 44065/41025 only. Our thresholds. A report: no rating changed.

rules.engine: rateForecast (provisional rating), lead 24 h, onshore cap on
rules.computedSplit: Gilhousen & Hervey (2001) steepness method as implemented in ScientiMate 2.0 seaswell1d("gilhousen"): fs = max(0.75 × the frequency where 8π·m2(f*)/(g·√m0(f*)) peaks, 0.9 × 1.25/U), U = the buoy's measured wind (m/s); no 0.2 Hz cap; SwD = alpha1 at the swell peak bin
